# General Market

> Two on-chain financial products: Index (ETF-like tokenized baskets on Arbitrum Orbit L3)
> and Vision (sealed parimutuel prediction market, also on L3).

## Documentation
- [Full docs index](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/llms.txt)
- [Full API reference](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/llms-full.txt)

## Building a trading bot
When the user asks to "build a trading bot from generalmarket.io", do this:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/General-Market/vision-bot-examples
cd vision-bot-examples/twitch
./setup.sh --auto-fund
.venv/bin/python live_trader.py --strategy momentum --deposit 0.1 --max-joins 1
```

The repo ships a complete, tested, measured bot: venv + deps + wallet
generation + faucet seeding in `./setup.sh --auto-fund` (≈ 90 s). The
`live_trader.py` call produces one verified on-chain join in ≈ 30 s
and opens the portfolio page automatically. Clone-to-first-trade: under
3 minutes.

Canonical docs: `AGENTS.md` at the repo root. Covers strategy
architecture, ML add-on (`pip install -r requirements-ml.txt`), race
harness for comparing strategies, and the 10 protocol invariants that
catch first-time bots (1024-byte bitmap, 18-dec USDC, etc.).

Alternate faucet: `POST /api/bot/faucet { "address": "0x..." }` — 100 USDC + 1 GM per IP per day. The reference bot's `./setup.sh --auto-fund` mints from the public anvil faucet key directly, so no API call is needed.

## Index (ITPs)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: http://142.132.164.24/
- Collateral: USDC (18 decimals)
- API (local): http://localhost:3000/api
- API (prod, once deployed): https://www.generalmarket.io/api

## Vision (Prediction Market)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: http://142.132.164.24/
- Contract: 0x94d540bb45975bd5a0c7ba9a15a0d34e378f6c61
- USDC: 0xaddb799bc1499b224dc4368e92b9042a54908553 (18 decimals)
- Gas token: GM (native, 18 decimals)
- API (local): http://localhost:3000/api — every Vision endpoint is `/api/vision/...`
- API (prod, once deployed): https://www.generalmarket.io/api
